title: Give each Windows HTTPS data-branch test child at least a 4x margin under its 120 s supervisor deadline
outcome: Give each Windows HTTPS data-branch test child at least a 4x margin under its 120 s supervisor deadline
acceptance: Every Windows real-HTTPS data-branch workflow child, run uncontended in the isolated pass, finishes in at most 30 s against its 120 s supervisor deadline (>=4x), shown by the per-child elapsed_ms ... deadline_ms=120000 lines of a Windows gate log; the margin is reached structurally (smaller children, per-phase bounds or less fixture work), never by raising the deadline
A per-phase cost breakdown of each workflow child, from its phase trace, is recorded before the restructuring and names where the time goes
The restructured workflows keep every existing behavioural assertion
